text: {"score":4,"justification":"The summary is accurate and well grounded in the card: 23.5% vs 3.1% expected, risk-adjusted 6.30, z 3.06, 37% low complexity (0.368), 30 records, 4 of 5 99215 below billed (80%), and 1 of 11 data-reviewed notes with no lab line all match. The headline's 14 of 23 (61%) is a legitimate sum (10+4 below billed over 18+5 documented), which explains why the script could not match 61. Language is cautious ('not a finding'), and the cited claims support their sentences. Weaknesses: the comparison '14%' is the all-provider 99215 rate, which is fine, but the rationale does not mention the 99214 documentation data (10 of 18 below billed) that drives the headline. The 'patients with 0 or 1 conditions' claim is fine. The next steps are fairly generic. There is a minor age discrepancy: C0052042 is aged 46 on the card, which matches. C0051986 shows age 82, which also matches. Two example claims (C0051980, C0051985) have no documentation, so only the complexity point is supported. Missing items are not flagged explicitly, such as the low documented share (12%).","problems":["Headline figure 61% is a derived sum not explained in the body; the body never presents the 99214 breakdown (10 of 18 below billed) behind it","Next steps are generic and do not name specific claims to request beyond 'cited claims'","Does not flag that only 12% of claims have documentation, limiting generalization","Two of five cited claims (C0051980, C0051985) have no documentation, so they support only the complexity point","Does not note that the sole supported 99215 (C0052179) exists, or any counter-evidence"]}
